_about: Ethylbenzene (1) + Sulfolane (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.33 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of ethylbenzene, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of ethylbenzene, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Z. Wang, L. Huang, S. Xia, P. Ma, Isobaric (vapour + liquid) equilibria for sulfolane with toluene, ethylbenzene, and isopropylbenzene at 101.33 kPa, J. Chem. Thermodyn. 43 (2011) 1865-1869
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 7, 8. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0042. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
